Hannah — bumping this thread since Jordan hasn’t responded to the walkthrough invite and Legal hasn’t confirmed back. I recommend one of two approaches to re-engage:

Option A (low-friction): Send a short, time-limited "review window" note that asks if they can confirm by EOD next Tue whether they want the walkthrough. Include a single ask and an alternate small deliverable (example: a one-page controls summary specific to EU residency).

Option B (escalation): Offer a brief 15-minute executive alignment call (me + Hannah + Jordan + their Legal lead) to unblock procurement timelines — signal priority but keep the ask small.

If we don’t hear back by next Tue EOD, I suggest we mark as low priority in the pipeline and reach back after their quarter close. Also — Priya, if we can pre-stage the precise KMS wording and the two most likely evidence exports (auth logs + config snapshot), we can respond instantly when they reply.

Cheers — Ben
